Three Tokyo nights before a bullet train.
The cheapest base saved about ¥40,000 👇

1️⃣ Ueno
Skyliner from Narita in as little as 41 min.
Three nights for two from about ¥41,000.

2️⃣ Tokyo Station
The easiest last morning.
But about ¥84,000, roughly double.

3️⃣ Shinagawa
For days around Shibuya.
From about ¥59,000.

📅 14–17 Dec 2026, 2 adults, Booking.com.

✅ Our pick: Ueno.
It costs about 13 extra minutes, once.
